purpose: Teach: 聖なる/僧侶/悲観/電化/断食/途方/悪徳/投影

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様の信頼を聖なる契約と考えろ
lines.en: Treat our customers' trust as a sacred contract.
lines.style: Crisp, measured authority. Short, declarative sentences. Each principle lands with quiet weight. Pauses between statements like carved stone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の中で僧侶資格を持つ方も尊重します
lines.en: Yes. I understand—we value that commitment.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Measured, slightly formal. The rhythm of acknowledgment and agreement. Not echoing back, but confirming his own alignment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、過度な悲観論で社員を萎縮させるな
lines.en: Don't let excessive pessimism shrink our staff.
lines.style: Firm pivot. The word 'shrink' carries weight—protection, not reprimand. Steady eye contact level. Still quiet authority, but the tone sharpens slightly with emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の電化を進めて省エネにします
lines.en: Understood. We'll support new hires so they don't feel lost.
lines.style: Quick processing—he's already moving to the answer. Practical, forward-looking. No defensiveness, just action. Slightly faster tempo than before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に断食を強要するな
lines.en: Never force our people to go without.
lines.style: Harder edge here. The word 'force' carries visible disapproval. Short. Direct. Less philosophical than the previous points—this one is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。途方に暮れる新人を支援する制度を作ります
lines.en: Yes. We'll ensure proper support systems are in place.
lines.style: Responsive but not rushed. He's taking mental notes. Professional cadence. The kind of agreement that suggests he's already thinking through implementation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、悪徳業者との取引は厳禁だ
lines.en: No dealings with unethical operators—that's absolute.
lines.style: Final statement weight. The word 'absolute' lands with finality. Composed, non-negotiable. The close of a creed. Slight downward inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プレゼンの投影機を最新型にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we're equipped with the best tools.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Professional, efficient. A small nod to the practical detail beneath the principles. Calm wrap-up—the meeting's conclusion implied in his tone.
